```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Todo App Realtime</title>
    <!-- Include Tailwind CSS -->
    @include('vendor.tailwindcss.full')
    <!-- Include Alpine.js -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.x.x/dist/cdn.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-100 font-sans">
    <!-- Sidebar -->
    <aside class="fixed left-0 top-0 z-50 w-full bg-white shadow-md transition duration-200 ease-in-out lg:hidden">
        <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8">
            <h1 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-700">Todo App</h1>
            <button @click="toggleSidebar" class="mt-4 w-full py-2 px-4 rounded-md bg-blue-500 text-white hover:bg-blue-600 focus:outline-none focus:bg-blue-700">
                Toggle Sidebar
            </button>
        </div>
    </aside>

    <!-- Main Content -->
    <main class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-screen overflow-x-hidden lg:w-3/4 lg:max-w-6xl">
        <!-- Navigation -->
        <nav class="bg-gray-800 shadow-lg rounded-t-md sm:shadow-xl lg:bg-blue-500 dark:bg-gray-900 lg:dark:bg-gray-700 dark:text-white transition duration-200 ease-in-out lg:hidden">
            <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8">
                <h1 class="text-lg font-bold text-white">Todo App</h1>
                <ul class="space-y-2 mt-4 w-full text-sm font-medium leading-5 text-gray-700">
                    @foreach ($navigation as $item)
                        <li><a href="#!" class="hover:text-blue-500">{{ $item }}</a></li>
                    @endforeach
                </ul>
            </div>
        </nav>

        <!-- Content Area -->
        <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-screen overflow-x-hidden lg:w-3/4 lg:max-w-6xl">
            {!! $slot ?? '' !!}
        </div>

        <!-- Footer -->
        <footer class="bg-gray-800 text-white py-4 sm:py-8 rounded-b-md lg:hidden">
            <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8">
                <h1 class="text-lg font-bold text-white">Todo App</h1>
                <ul class="space-y-2 mt-4 w-full text-sm font-medium leading-5 text-gray-700">
                    @foreach ($footer as $item)
                        <li><a href="#!" class="hover:text-blue-500">{{ $item }}</a></li>
                    @endforeach
                </ul>
            </div>
        </footer>

        <!-- Sidebar Toggle Script -->
        <script>
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
                const sidebar = document.querySelector('.fixed.left-0.top-0.z-50.w-full.bg-white.shadow-md.transition.duration-200 ease-in-out lg:hidden');
                const toggleSidebar = () => {
                    if (sidebar.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                        sidebar.classList.remove('hidden');
                    } else {
                        sidebar.classList.add('hidden');
                    }
                };
            });
        </script>
    </main>

    <!-- Alpine.js Scripts -->
    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            Alpine.data('app', {
                navigation: ['Home', 'Tasks', 'Settings'],
                footer: ['About Us', 'Contact Us']
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
